Jwt._comment: SecretKey is loaded from the JWT_SecretKey env var (.env / secret store). Never commit the signing key.

_payments_comment: Sandbox credentials. Put the SECRET fields (SecretKey/HashSecret/AccessKey) in .env as Momo__SecretKey / VnPay__HashSecret etc. — do NOT commit real secrets. The URLs below already point at the sandbox; only fill the merchant credentials.

VnPay._comment: Put TmnCode/HashSecret in .env as VnPay__TmnCode / VnPay__HashSecret — do NOT commit. ReturnUrl points at the FE deposit-return page; register it as the merchant Return URL in the VNPay portal.

PayOs._comment: Put ClientId/ApiKey/ChecksumKey in .env as PayOs__ClientId / PayOs__ApiKey / PayOs__ChecksumKey — do NOT commit. Register the webhook URL (…/api/wallet/deposit/payos-webhook) in the PayOS dashboard.

Smtp._comment: OTP email sender. Put User/Password in .env as Smtp__User / Smtp__Password — do NOT commit. For Gmail: Host smtp.gmail.com, Port 587, UseStartTls true, Password = a 16-char App Password (not your normal password).

S3._comment: Image/avatar uploads. Put AccessKey/SecretKey in .env as S3__AccessKey / S3__SecretKey (or leave empty in prod and use the ECS task role). BucketName + Region are required. PublicBaseUrl is optional (CloudFront/custom domain).
